medium: Resume re-derives crawler options from current CLI defaults (scanner.js:535 optionsForCrawler) instead of scans.options_json: a scan created with --max-depth 3/--scope host resumed without flags silently runs maxDepth 6/same-origin (getScan reads only target).
low: Under --scope any robots.txt is fetched only for the target origin (crawl.js:556-588), so non-origin hosts are crawled without their robots rules.
UA group matching is bidirectional includes (crawl.js:296), broader than token match.

edge_anomaly: Not non-determinism or duplication. The 20-edge baseline ran --max-depth 3, while the interrupted run and its resume both used --max-depth 6 (verification.json raw command). At depth 6 /page4.html is fetched (depth 4); its only link /page5.html was already an unresolved node discovered from /page3.html, so exactly one new link edge page4->page5 is added with no new node (page5 node pre-existed), giving 21 vs 20 with the same 18 nodes. Edge identity is UNIQUE(scan_id,src,dst,kind) (migrate.js:146) and addEdge is INSERT OR IGNORE (db.js:533), so a duplicate triple cannot exist; node identity is UNIQUE(scan_id,key). Severity low: comparison artifact plus the medium option-drift issue above.
